name: Chamomile
in_game_effect_text: Strengthens agility and speech and induces hunger.

name: Comfrey
in_game_effect_text: Greatly helps the health and stamina, but induces fatigue.

name: Hypericum
in_game_effect_text: Improves agility as well as stamina, but somewhat takes away strength and vitality.

name: Mint
in_game_effect_text: Improves speech and dispels fatigue, but increases hunger.

name: Paris
in_game_effect_text: Reduces stamina, induces sleep and lowers health.

name: Salvia
in_game_effect_text: Improves strength and vitality. It reduces speech.

name: Urticaria
in_game_effect_text: Improves health, but lowers speech and vitality.

name: Valerian
in_game_effect_text: Renews health and energy, but lessens strength.

name: Wormwood
in_game_effect_text: Greatly increases strength and dispels fatigue, but lowers speech.
